query:
INSERT INTO pairing_requests ("publicId", "userId", "deviceId", "deviceName", "systemName", status, "expiresAt", code, "clientIp", "clientNet", "legacyClient")
               VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, $1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
               ON CONFLICT (code) WHERE status = 'pending' DO NOTHING
               RETURNING "publicId"
